The transferFrom function does not check if the spender has enough allowance to transfer the specified amount of tokens from the sender. This can be exploited by malicious users to transfer more tokens than they have approved for transfer.

The approve function does not check if the spender has enough allowance to transfer the specified amount of tokens from the sender. This can be exploited by malicious users to approve more tokens than they have in their balance.

The batchTransfer function does not check if the sender has enough allowance to transfer the specified amount of tokens to each receiver. This can be exploited by malicious users to transfer more tokens than they have approved for transfer.
